messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to unpin SDK 3.2.1 from hosted canary at 23:00 UTC tonight. Runtime 2.15 landed a kernel tweak that regresses longseq for quant models. Change window 23:00–02:00 UTC. Observed ~2x tail latency on llama2-quant in eu-west. Telemetry: https://internal/reports/issue-1768
liam: Ack. Need rollback criteria and an explicit escape hatch. Who owns the canary rollout? @ops-sre?
ops-sre: I'll own the rollback/watch window. Deploybot will pin runtime back to 2.14 if error_rate > 1% or p99 latency > 800ms sustained for 5m. I'll monitor charts and traces.
dina: Can we do a staged unpin? Start at 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% if green. Also route quant-v3 models to the pinned runtime as a safety net.
maya: Yes — plan: 23:00 start -> 10% for 20m + smoke, then 50% for 30m, then 100% if no regressions. Release notes draft: https://internal/notes/release-176823 (will add customer-facing blurb).
raj: SDK note: clients using early-binding to KV cache may see incompatibilities. We'll ship a short-term header opt-in: X-RW-SDK-Compat: legacy. Add to release notes and SDK changelog.
liam: Ops checklist items: add telemetry flags 'unpin.sdk3_2_1' and 'canary.unpin'; enable verbose kvcache traces for the canary cohort.
deploybot: schedule created by @maya. job id: deploy-176823-01. Staged rollout steps attached. To cancel: `/deploy cancel deploy-176823-01`.
ops-sre: Runbook snippet (quick):
```
# rollback signal
if error_rate > 0.01 or p99 > 0.8s for 5m:
  deploybot pin runtime=2.14 all
  notify #incidents @oncall
  escalate to eng-runtime on-call
```
dina: QA request: please run longseq regression with quant-v3 on llama2-13b against canary. Small testset at /qa/corp/longseq/1768. I can run smoke after the 10% step.
maya: Tagging @support for release notes and @marketing for customer comms. We'll prepare a short Status page post if rollback happens. Also adding a note to the public changelog about transient perf improvement attempts.
raj: I've got a tiny SDK hotfix that toggles user-agent behavior for compatibility, but we won't push it pre-change window — will stand by to cut a 3.2.2 if rollback triggers.
liam: Final: proceeding with 23:00 change window and staged unpin as above. Everyone please ack in thread if you are on-call/monitoring.
maya: ack
dina: :thumbsup:
raj: ack
ops-sre: standing by — will post live metrics and the first 10% status at 23:20 UTC.
deploybot: status update (automated): step 1 scheduled at 1768233600, job deploy-176823-01 queued.
